textAnnotate.label: Text annotation
textAnnotate.summary: Tokens, sentences and dependencies for one or more documents, saved as an App document.
textAnnotate.inputPlaceholder: Text to annotate. It is sent exactly as written.
textAnnotate.emptyHint: Enter one document, add more in Parameters, then run the Job.
textAnnotate.footnote: Runs the text.annotate Job through the current App AIConfig. The complete result is saved as an App document.
textAnnotate.languageHint: A lowercase language code such as en. Runtime reports languages its selected model does not support.
textAnnotate.inputInvalid: Enter a lowercase language code and at least one non-empty document (at most 64).
textAnnotate.resultMissing: The completed Job returned no annotation result.
textAnnotate.resultMismatch: The annotation does not match the submitted documents.
textAnnotate.saveFailed: The annotation completed, but saving its App document failed: {{detail}}
textAnnotate.saveMismatch: The saved annotation document did not match the written bytes and was removed.

textTools.label: Tools & structured output
textTools.summary: A fixed test tool or a fixed JSON Schema through text.generate, checked by the App.
textTools.inputPlaceholder: Request for the model. It is sent exactly as written.
textTools.emptyHint: Choose the tool call or structured output test in Parameters.
textTools.footnote: Runs through the current text.generate App AIConfig. Only the fixed, side-effect-free test tool can run.
textTools.toolScenario: Tool call with a matching ToolResult
textTools.structuredScenario: Structured output with a fixed JSON Schema
textTools.toolHint: The model may call lab_convert_centimeters. The App checks the tool name, arguments and call ID, computes the result and sends it back with the same ID.
textTools.structuredHint: The request declares the fixed lab_release_note schema (title, priority, tags). The App parses the final text and checks those fields.
textTools.stopped: Stopped before the next model step.
textTools.checkFailed: The test failed: {{detail}} Exchange so far: {{steps}}
textTools.toolPassed: The tool call test passed: the matching ToolResult was accepted and the model answered.
textTools.schemaPassed: The structured output test passed: the final text parsed and matched the fixed schema.
textTools.inputRequired: Enter the text for this test.
textTools.argumentsNotObject: The arguments must be a JSON object.
textTools.argumentsShape: The arguments must contain exactly one finite number "centimeters".
textTools.notJson: The final text is not valid JSON.
textTools.notObject: The structured result is not a JSON object.
textTools.undeclaredFields: The structured result has undeclared fields: {{fields}}.
textTools.priorityInvalid: "priority" must be low, medium or high.
textTools.tagsInvalid: "tags" must be an array of strings.
textTools.toolNotCalled: The model did not call the declared tool {{tool}}.
textTools.noFinalText: The model returned no final text after the tool result.
textTools.unexpectedToolCall: The structured output test declared no tools, but the model returned a tool call.
textTools.undeclaredTool: The model called an undeclared tool: {{tool}}.
textTools.toolCallIdInvalid: The tool call ID is missing or repeated: {{id}}.
textTools.argumentsInvalid: The tool call {{id}} has invalid arguments: {{detail}}
textTools.tooManySteps: The model kept calling tools after {{steps}} steps.

textDecide.label: Decisions
textDecide.summary: Typed choice and yes/no decisions about one text or JSON state, with the probability of every option.
textDecide.inputNote: Open Parameters to edit the state and questions, or to load an example.
textDecide.emptyHint: Enter a state and at least one question in Parameters, then run.
textDecide.footnote: Runs text.decide through the current App AIConfig, on the Local or Cloud route saved there.
textDecide.routeHint: Nimi runs this on the Local or Cloud route saved in this App's AIConfig; Lab never chooses a backend.
textDecide.statePlaceholderText: What the questions are about. It is sent exactly as written.
textDecide.question: Question {{index}}
textDecide.instructionsPlaceholder: What to decide. It is sent exactly as written.
textDecide.timeoutHint: From 1 to 120000. When set, the call ends with a timeout if no result has arrived by then.

issues.stateJsonInvalid: The state is not valid JSON: {{detail}}
issues.stateJsonNotContainer: A JSON state must be one object or array.
issues.idSpaces: Remove the spaces before or after the ID.
issues.questionIdRepeated: Another question already uses this ID.
issues.candidateIdSpaces: Remove the spaces before or after candidate IDs.
issues.candidateIdRepeated: Candidate IDs in one question must differ.
issues.timeout: Enter a whole number from 1 to 120000, or leave the timeout empty.

textDecide.stopped: Stopped before the decisions returned. A result that arrives later is discarded.
textDecide.unexpectedOutput: Runtime returned an output that is not a decision.
textDecide.resultMismatch: The decisions do not match the submitted questions and candidates.

imageFaceSwap.label: Image face swap
imageFaceSwap.summary: Replace the face in a target image with the face from a reference image.
imageFaceSwap.inputTitle: Swap a face in an image
imageFaceSwap.inputNote: Open Parameters to choose a reference image and a target image (JPEG or PNG, one clear face each).
imageFaceSwap.emptyHint: Choose both images in Parameters, then run the Job.
imageFaceSwap.footnote: Uploads both images as App-owned artifacts and runs the image.face_swap Job through the current App AIConfig.
imageFaceSwap.pending: Waiting for the face swap Job…

videoFaceSwap.label: Video face swap
videoFaceSwap.summary: Replace faces in a short MP4 with a reference face, or test the frame Session.
videoFaceSwap.inputNote: Open Parameters to choose a reference image, a short MP4 and what to do with frames that have no face. Use Session test for individual frames.
videoFaceSwap.emptyHint: Choose the reference, video and no-face policy in Parameters, then run the Job.
videoFaceSwap.footnote: Uploads both inputs as App-owned artifacts and runs the video.face_swap Job. The result video is kept by adopting its artifact.
videoFaceSwap.pending: Waiting for the video face swap Job…

faceSwap.imageInputInvalid: Choose a JPEG or PNG reference and target, each at most 32 MiB.
faceSwap.videoInputInvalid: Choose a JPEG or PNG reference and an MP4 target, each at most 32 MiB.
faceSwap.policyRequired: Choose what to do with frames that have no target face.
faceSwap.unexpectedOutput: The completed Job did not return exactly one output of the expected type.
faceSwap.summaryInvalid: The completed video Job returned no consistent frame summary.
faceSwap.completed: Face swap completed and the result was saved.
faceSwap.imageFileInvalid: Choose a JPEG or PNG image of at most 32 MiB.
faceSwap.videoFileInvalid: Choose an MP4 video of at most 32 MiB.
faceSwap.imageHint: Each image should contain exactly one clear face. Runtime reports missing or ambiguous faces with their own reasons.
faceSwap.videoHint: The current profile is a short H.264 MP4 at a constant 24, 25 or 30 fps with at most one AAC audio track. Runtime reports anything else with its reason.

videoSession.title: Video face swap Session
videoSession.description: A separate frame-by-frame test. It is not a Job, and frames are not saved.
videoSession.intro: Choose a reference image and up to four frames. The reference is uploaded as an App-owned artifact, the Session opens, and each frame is sent as 1280×720 RGB8. A receipt only confirms the frame was accepted; results arrive separately.

videoSession.inputPixels: Session input must be 1280×720 RGBA pixels before packing.
videoSession.framePixels: A Session frame must be 1280×720 packed RGB8.
videoSession.noPixels: The input image has no pixels.
videoSession.previewEncodeFailed: The frame preview could not be encoded.
